description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VBR.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 恢复被终止的边界路由器（VBR）

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口后VBR从**terminated**状态变为**recovering**状态，恢复成功后进入**active**状态。

在调用本接口恢复VBR之前，请注意： 
      
- 只有物理专线的所有者可以调用该接口。  

- VBR所属的物理专线必须处于**Enabled**状态。
descriptions.en:
After you call this operation, the VBR changes from the **terminated** state to the **recovering** state. After the operation is performed, the VBR enters the **active** state.

When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

*   Only the owner of the Express Connect circuit can call this operation.
*   The Express Connect circuit to which the VBR connects must be in the **Enabled** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc recover-virtual-border-router --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id vbr-bp1lhl0taikrte0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
